figures.cap: double box-and-whisker plot for Test A and Test B

solutions.latex:
Read the five-number summaries from the plots.

$$\begin{aligned} \text{Test A: } & Q_1=18,\ Q_3=26,\ \text{range}=30-13=17 \\ \text{Test B: } & Q_1=22,\ Q_3=30,\ \text{range}=33-17=16 \end{aligned}$$

$$\begin{aligned} \text{IQR}_A &= 26-18=8 \\ \text{IQR}_B &= 30-22=8 \end{aligned}$$

The medians differ ($21$ and $24$), the ranges differ ($17$ and $16$), and the mean cannot be read from a box plot. Hence the interquartile range is the same, option A.

707_q13_1.notes: Two horizontal box plots on a 12–34 scale with ticks every 2. Test A: 13, 18, 21, 26, 30. Test B: 17, 22, 24, 30, 33. Boxes, medians and whiskers are 0.9pt (rule 9); the axis is 0.6pt. The red and blue boxes are drawn in black (rule 6). Rules 1, 2, 3, 6, 9, 11 and 19 applied.
